Field Notes.text: MIT. No licence key, no watermark.

tldraw.text: The tldraw SDK is free in development and needs a licence key in production: a commercial licence, a 100-day trial, or a discretionary hobby licence for non-commercial projects that shows a "made with tldraw" watermark.

Excalidraw.text: The Excalidraw repository is under the MIT licence.

Field Notes.text: None. The core package is vanilla TypeScript, and the React, Vue, Svelte and Angular bindings are separate packages.

tldraw.text: The tldraw SDK is a React library, used through the Tldraw component.

Excalidraw.text: @excalidraw/excalidraw is a React component, installed together with react and react-dom.

Field Notes.text: @fieldnotes/sync-server is a WebSocket relay you run yourself. @fieldnotes/sync-redis adds Redis persistence.

tldraw.text: tldraw sync is a multiplayer sync library that you host yourself, from a Cloudflare template or with @tldraw/sync-core on a JavaScript server that supports WebSockets.

Excalidraw.text: The @excalidraw/excalidraw package has no collaboration built in. Each host app implements its own.

rows.label: Arbitrary HTML elements on the board

Field Notes.text: addHtmlElement puts any DOM node on the board, where it pans, zooms and sits in layer order with the drawing.

tldraw.text: Custom shapes can render HTML through the HTMLContainer component.

Excalidraw.text: Embeddable elements render as iframes, and the renderEmbeddable prop can replace that renderer.

Field Notes.text: @fieldnotes/vtt adds square and hex grids, fog of war, a measuring tool and area templates.
@fieldnotes/core 0.109.0 is 122.1 kB, with no runtime dependencies.

Excalidraw.text: @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1 is 352.7 kB for the main chunk, and more code loads in separate chunks.

Field Notes.text: The board reads Pointer Events, so mouse, touch and pen drive the same tools. Pen pressure sets the stroke's width, and a resting palm is ignored while a pen is down.

tldraw.text: The editor listens to Pointer Events, so mouse, touch and pen input use the same handlers.

Field Notes.text: No tool toolbar or style panel. Your app calls viewport.setTool from its own controls. The board has its own context menu and command palette.

tldraw.text: The tldraw package includes a complete interface with menus, toolbars, keyboard shortcuts and style panels.

Excalidraw.text: The Excalidraw component renders its main menu with default options unless the app supplies its own.

Field Notes.text: Sticky notes have a formatting toolbar, on by default.

tldraw.text: Text is rich text built on TipTap, with bold, italic, code, highlighting, lists and links.

Excalidraw.text: Rich text editing is an open feature request.

Field Notes.text: PNG, SVG and PDF. A PDF has one page per frame or one for the board.

Excalidraw.text: The export utilities produce a canvas, an image blob, an SVG or clipboard data.

Field Notes.text: A frame groups and clips the elements added to it, and can be exported on its own.

tldraw.text: The frame shape is a container with a labelled header that holds other shapes.

Excalidraw.text: Frames were introduced in pull request 6123.

Field Notes.text: Named layers that can be hidden, locked, faded and reordered.

tldraw.text: The docs include a layers panel as an example that lists, selects, renames and hides shapes.

Excalidraw.text: Layers are an open feature request.

Field Notes.text: viewport.presentation.start() steps through the frames with the arrow keys.

tldraw.text: The docs include a slideshow example built from a custom slide shape.

Excalidraw.text: The open-source app links to Excalidraw+ for presentations.

Field Notes.text: The repository was created in March 2026. One maintainer, 8 GitHub stars.

tldraw.text: The repository was created in May 2021 and has 51.6k GitHub stars.

Excalidraw.text: The repository was created in January 2020 and has 136.3k GitHub stars.
